independence.sources: Read-only public primary astronomical tables and classical-text transcriptions; no natal input submitted to any external calculator.
independence.expected_method: USNO Gregorian day number relative to visually checked official HKO day anchor; cited discrete classical rules; manually transcribed independent HKO jie timestamps. Seeds choose only fictitious inputs.

limits: HKO jie times were visually read from each 2024 monthly PDF, published to minutes. +/-60 seconds is a conservative comparison guard, not an HKO-certified error bound.
No expected year/month is issued within the source precision guard. No astronomical claim for +/-1 second solar-term boundaries.
Classical rules use named profile conventions, not a scientific validation of fortune-telling.

Classical web transcriptions were read; original historical printed folios were not independently collated. In particular MLTY's transcription contains a ten-versus-eleven o'clock typo; HKO supplies the 23:00 Zi boundary and the explicit next-day-stem example supplies late-Zi hour policy.
Hidden stem membership is asserted; order, percentages and principal/secondary ranking are display conventions and not independent expected truth.
Nayin spelling aliases must normalize 泉中水/井泉水, 沙中金/砂中金, 沙中土/砂中土, 覆灯火/佛灯火; the source spelling is returned.
Qiyun returns an elapsed-time interval and formal 360-day-year age interval. Gregorian start-date addition, nominal age, rounding policy and sub-shichen interpolation are not independently asserted.

Built-in complete natal samples use 2024-01-07 through 2024-12-05 with adjacent independent jie; other epochs require independently sourced external jie records with source_id and uncertainty_seconds.
Annual pillar labels begin at Lichun; annual list does not assert age columns or Jan-1 transitions.

Synthetic samples cover all 12 hour branches by deterministic time selection and male/female direction; they do not establish historical DST, IANA conversion, true-solar-time or astronomical ephemeris accuracy.
